AWS Architecture Icons — usage rules (CC-BY-ND 2.0)

Source:   awslabs/aws-icons-for-plantuml (https://github.com/awslabs/aws-icons-for-plantuml)
Original: AWS Architecture Icons (https://aws.amazon.com/architecture/icons/)
License:  Creative Commons Attribution-NoDerivatives 2.0 (CC-BY-ND 2.0)

The "NoDerivatives" clause means the icons are redistributed VERBATIM only:
  - Do NOT resize, re-encode, recolor, crop, flip, or rotate the icons.
  - Modifying an icon (including resizing) creates a derivative work, which
    CC-BY-ND forbids. This repo ships AWS PNGs byte-identical to upstream; a
    CI gate enforces it.
  - Attribution required: "AWS Architecture Icons" (c) Amazon Web Services, Inc.
    or its affiliates.
  - Do not use an AWS icon to represent your own product or service.

This project is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Amazon Web
Services. AWS and the AWS logo are trademarks of Amazon.com, Inc. or its
affiliates.
